definition: a small metal piece fired from a gun
description: In a dark laboratory a brass-coloured bullet with a copper tip passes through a red apple on a steel rod. Its far side bursts open in a spray of white flesh and juice, and a ring of air and water ripples around the bullet as it flies on and out of view. Water drops fall in straight lines from above, a block of ice smokes at the base, small metal sensors with red laser beams stand on the bench, and a sheet of crumpled gold foil hangs behind. Apple pieces lie scattered on the bench.

taps.phrase: to speed away from the apple
